paragraphs: Amped Software develops software for the analysis and enhancement of images and videos for forensic, security and investigative applications. Amped FIVE covers forensic image and video enhancement, while Amped Authenticate tests whether digital images and videos are reliable and admissible in court. Amped DVRConv converts batches of unplayable video files from proprietary CCTV and DVR formats, dash cams and body-worn cameras.

The tools are used for multimedia forensics in public safety and national security in over 100 countries. That customer base is put at more than 1500 organizations and more than 6000 licenses and seats sold. Training courses give hands-on instruction on the products and on forensic video and digital multimedia evidence processing.

Martino Jerian founded Amped Software in 2008 in Trieste, Italy, after graduating in Electronic Engineering at the University of Trieste. A subsidiary was established in Brooklyn, NY, as Amped Software USA Inc. The team numbers 41 people from 9 different countries, including former law enforcement officers and military.
